title: Worker-spawning observers fail under the driver acceptance sandbox
body: Outcome: a declared --observer that spawns krn worker start/stop either runs in the Codex workspace-write sandbox or is reported as sandbox-incompatible, instead of failing 'worker stop did not finish' while passing on the host. Evidence: PR #192 round 001 acceptance-3.log (.krn/runs/lead/brief-guard/rounds/001/) exit 1 in sandbox; same file 10/10 pass on host. Proof: test/worker/acceptance-checks.test.ts case red at base by assertion.
